title: Masters Edition III: card flavor text

entities.name: Liu Bei
entities.description: Lord of the Shu kingdom, who founded it with his Tiger Generals and values wisdom and virtue.

entities.name: Kongming
entities.description: Strategist of Shu who tricked Wei into shooting arrows, planned the fire at Red Cliffs and captured Meng Huo seven times.

entities.name: Zhou Yu
entities.description: Wu strategist who wrote the same plan, fire, as Kongming at Red Cliffs.

entities.name: Cao Cao
entities.description: Ruler of Wei who defeated Yuan Shao at Guandu and was haunted to death by ghosts of those he murdered.

entities.name: Sun Quan
entities.description: Lord of the Wu kingdom, said to have reigned twenty-four years.

entities.name: Lu Meng
entities.description: Wu chief commander who conquered Jingzhou in 219 by disguising soldiers as merchants.

entities.name: Zhang Fei
entities.description: Shu warrior who allied with Yan Yan to advance through Riverlands strongpoints.

entities.name: Ma Chao
entities.description: A general who surrendered to Liu Bei and became a Tiger General, and who fought Cao Cao at Chang'an.

entities.name: Meng Huo
entities.description: A stubborn barbarian king captured and released by Kongming seven times.

entities.name: Lu Bu
entities.description: Dong Zhuo's warrior without peer.

entities.name: Gan Ning
entities.description: Wu general who raided Cao Cao's camp with 100 cavalry without loss.

entities.name: Zhang Liao
entities.description: Wei general who defeated Sun Quan at Hefei.

entities.name: Yuan Shao
entities.description: A rival defeated by Cao Cao at Guandu after losing his grain.

entities.name: Lu Su
entities.description: Wu official who helped Kongming gather arrows.

entities.name: Wei
entities.description: One of the three kingdoms, led by Cao Cao.

entities.name: Shu
entities.description: One of the three kingdoms, founded by Liu Bei.

entities.name: Wu
entities.description: One of the three kingdoms, led by Sun Quan.

entities.name: Jingzhou
entities.description: The fulcrum province of the three kingdoms.

entities.name: Red Cliffs
entities.description: Site where Kongming and Zhou Yu planned a fire attack on Wei.

entities.name: Halvor Arenson
entities.description: A Kjeldoran priest who says small boons can save a life.

entities.name: General Jarkeld
entities.description: A general known as the Arctic Fox.

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: A Kjeldoran royal mage who speaks of the potential for change in all things.

entities.name: Onatah
entities.description: An Anaba shaman who hopes labyrinth minotaurs persist and sings of Feroz.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: A figure who delivered the Anaba people.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: An Anaba who owes a debt to the Ancestors.

entities.name: Halina
entities.description: A dwarven trader who grumbles about seafaring muleheads.

entities.name: Reveka, Wizard Savant
entities.description: A dwarf wizard savant in a position of power.

entities.name: Nethya
entities.description: A woman who falls lifeless after Remove Soul.

entities.name: Ailheen
entities.description: Speaker of the Council who condemns the Elves of Deep Shadow.

entities.name: Joskun
entities.description: An An-Havva constable who praises faerie nobles as straight talkers.

entities.name: Maeveen O'Donagh
entities.description: A soldier whose memoir links rivers and sorting who goes first.

entities.name: General Chanek Valteroth
entities.description: A general who recalls his father's remark about war.

entities.name: Kolbjorn
entities.description: A high honored druid who warns plague's strength is not renewed health.

entities.name: Bearand the Bold
entities.description: A figure whose epitaph says kobolds are harmless.

entities.name: Autumn Willow
entities.description: A willow priestess who says those of faith are those of strength.

entities.name: Angus Mackenzie
entities.description: A Karakas figure who wrote in his diary that battles no longer served a purpose, and was burned by Lady Orca.

entities.name: Lady Orca
entities.description: A fiery-eyed woman who burned Angus Mackenzie to nothing in a flash of flame.

entities.name: Lord Ith
entities.description: A lord held for a dozen years in Barl's Cage.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: The Pretender whose weakening power weakened Barl's Cage.

entities.name: Lady Ursnell
entities.description: A lady who made the first bone flute from Lord Ursnell's leg.

entities.name: Lord Ursnell
entities.description: A lord whose left leg became the first bone flute.

entities.name: Lydia, Countess Brellis
entities.description: A countess who watched coal golems burning on a hill before a fireball struck her front line.

entities.name: Gerda Aagesdotter
entities.description: An archmage of the Unseen who praises concealment.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: A mighty cat warrior who left his tribe to lead the Robaran Mercenaries in the battle for Efrava.

entities.name: Jerrard of the Closed Fist
entities.description: The last of the Order of the Closed Fist.

entities.name: Sivitri Scarzam
entities.description: A figure who tamed Scarzam's Dragon.

entities.name: Tobias Andrion
entities.description: Administrator of Sheoltun, military right arm of the empire.

entities.name: Tuknir Deathlock
entities.description: An explorer of the Aether.

entities.name: Disa the Restless
entities.description: A journal writer who reports the Kjeldoran frostbeast's danger.

entities.name: Kher Keep
entities.description: A fortress impervious to aerial assault but defenseless from the ground.

entities.name: Karakas
entities.description: A land where battles no longer served a purpose.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Final resting place of many swordsmen outmatched by Gwendlyn.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria where rising oceans brought new lakes and terrors.

events.summary: Liu Bei's forces fight Ma Chao at Chengdu; Ma Chao surrenders and becomes one of Liu Bei's Tiger Generals.
events.quote: Eventually, Ma Chao surrendered and became one of Liu Bei's Tiger Generals.

events.summary: Zhang Fei allies with defeated Riverlands general Yan Yan so Shu advances through forty-five strongpoints with no casualties.
events.quote: allowed Shu forces to advance through forty-five Riverlands strongpoints with no casualties.

events.summary: Kongming and Lu Su trick Wei troops into shooting over 100,000 arrows to use against Wei at Red Cliffs.
events.quote: Kongming and Lu Su tricked Wei troops into shooting over 100,000 arrows at them

events.summary: Kongming and Zhou Yu each write the word Fire as their plan to defeat Wei at Red Cliffs.
events.quote: They laughed as they both revealed the same word, "Fire."

events.summary: Lu Meng conquers Shu-held Jingzhou in 219 by disguising soldiers as merchants.
events.quote: Lu Meng conquered Shu-held Jingzhou in 219 by disguising soldiers as merchants on boats filled with hiding troops.

events.summary: Gan Ning raids Cao Cao's camp of 400,000 with only 100 cavalry at the second battle of Ruxu without loss.
events.quote: Not a single man or horse was lost.

events.summary: Cao Cao is haunted to death by ghosts of the empresses and courtiers he had murdered.
events.quote: Cao Cao was haunted to death by the ghosts of the empresses and other high courtiers he had murdered.

events.summary: At Guandu, Cao Cao defeats Yuan Shao by raiding his grain depot.
events.quote: At the battle of Guandu, Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao by raiding his grain depot

events.summary: Zhang Liao defeats Sun Quan at Hefei and foils a Wu scheme to incite rebellion.
events.quote: Wei won the battle of Hefei when Zhang Liao defeated Sun Quan

events.summary: At Chang'an, Ma Chao defeats Cao Cao's two generals but flees when Cao Cao turns his ally against him.
events.quote: Ma Chao defeated the two generals Cao Cao sent to guard the pass

events.summary: Kongming captures and releases Meng Huo seven times before he surrenders.
events.quote: The stubborn Meng Huo was captured and released by Kongming seven times before finally surrendering.

events.summary: Liu Bei dismisses the Dilu horse's ill omen.
events.quote: All men have their appointed time; that's something no horse can change.

events.summary: Kongming's fire ambush at Bowang strikes fear into Cao Cao.
events.quote: With fire he broke the battle at Bowang

events.summary: Angus Mackenzie writes that battles no longer served a purpose in Karakas.
events.quote: Battles no longer served a purpose in Karakas.

events.summary: A wayfarer meets Lady Orca; a flash of flame leaves Angus gone.
events.quote: When I looked again, Angus was gone.

events.summary: Barl's Cage holds Lord Ith for a dozen years until Mairsil's power weakens.
events.quote: For a dozen years the Cage had held Lord Ith

events.summary: After the Battle of Pitdown, Lady Ursnell fashions the first bone flute from Lord Ursnell's left leg.
events.quote: After the Battle of Pitdown, Lady Ursnell fashioned the first such instrument out of Lord Ursnell's left leg.

events.summary: Lydia, Countess Brellis, watches three coal golems burn on a hill before a fireball strikes her line.
events.quote: Three such creatures stood burning at the crest of the hill.

events.summary: Rising oceans bring new lakes and terrors to Terisiare, where the Explorers find ancient enemies spawning.
events.quote: The rising oceans brought new lakes

events.summary: Nethya stiffens and falls lifeless as her soul is removed.
events.quote: Nethya stiffened suddenly

events.summary: Mairsil challenges what a victim has that he cannot obtain.
events.quote: What do you have that I cannot obtain?

relations.note: Titled Lord of Shu and founder of the kingdom.
relations.quote: In establishing the Shu kingdom, Liu Bei's forces fought against Ma Chao at Chengdu.

relations.note: He surrendered and became one of Liu Bei's Tiger Generals.
relations.quote: Eventually, Ma Chao surrendered and became one of Liu Bei's Tiger Generals.

relations.note: Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao at Guandu.
relations.quote: At the battle of Guandu, Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao by raiding his grain depot

relations.note: His victory won the battle of Hefei for Wei.
relations.quote: Wei won the battle of Hefei when Zhang Liao defeated Sun Quan

relations.note: Kongming captured and released Meng Huo seven times.
relations.quote: The stubborn Meng Huo was captured and released by Kongming seven times before finally surrendering.

relations.note: A wayfarer saw her fiery eyes, a flash, and Angus gone.
relations.quote: When I looked again, Angus was gone.

relations.note: Described as the brave Wu general.
relations.quote: At the second battle of Ruxu, the brave Wu general Gan Ning raided Cao Cao's camp
